arrays.description: List of RAID arrays to assemble automatically at boot. Each entry defines a unique array by UUID.

device.description: Device path for the assembled array (e.g., /dev/md0, /dev/md/raid1-data).

metadata.description: Metadata format: 'default', '1.0', '1.1', '1.2', 'imsm', 'ddf'. Leave as 'default' to auto-detect.

spares.description: Minimum number of spare devices to reserve for this array.

uuid.description: UUID of the array (required; e.g., a0b8d2c1-1234-5678-9abc-def012345678).

options.description: Key-value global options for mdadm behavior. Supported keys: homehost, bootdir, mailcmd, program.

rules.description: Device naming rules (advanced). Usually omitted; used only when custom udev-like device selection is needed (e.g., for unusual device naming).

scan_devices.description: List of device paths or patterns (e.g., /dev/sd*, /dev/disk/by-id/*) to scan for array components. Reduces boot time by limiting device scanning.
